title: den-wiki trails/ frontmatter
description: Frontmatter of a trail page: one research run or curation run. Trails are append-only.

type.description: Always "trail". OKF requires a type on every document; it also groups the generated index.

job.description: Research ledger job id. Absent for runs that were not queued as a ledger job.

finished.description: Absent while the run is in progress.

agent.description: Identity of the agent that ran the trail.

harness.description: Harness the agent ran in, for example claude-code, codex, dsh or hermes.
